recognize_zh: 脾臟切面佈滿無數大小一致、約 1–3 mm 的淡褐白色小結節，均勻散佈在暗紅褐色紅髓背景中，呈粟粒狀（miliary）多結節外觀，代表白髓擴大，符合脾邊緣區淋巴瘤。
features: Gross cut section of an enlarged spleen with intact smooth capsule
Innumerable uniform, small (about 1–3 mm) tan-white nodules distributed evenly throughout the parenchyma
Dark red-brown intervening red pulp background
No large confluent tumor masses, infarcts or hemorrhagic foci evident
describe_en: Gross photograph shows a cut section of spleen with a smooth intact capsule. The parenchyma is diffusely studded with innumerable uniform, small tan-white nodules on a dark red-brown background, imparting a miliary, micronodular appearance that reflects expansion of the white pulp. No discrete large masses, infarcts or areas of necrosis are seen. Findings are consistent with a white pulp-based small B-cell lymphoma and, in the given context, with splenic marginal zone lymphoma; histology and immunophenotyping are required for confirmation.

ddx.vs: HCL diffusely infiltrates the red pulp, producing a homogeneous beefy-red cut surface without discrete white pulp nodules.
HSTCL involves red pulp sinusoids and cords, giving a uniform dark red surface without miliary nodules.

ddx.dx: Other small B-cell lymphomas (CLL/SLL, mantle cell, follicular)
ddx.vs: These can also produce a micronodular white pulp pattern grossly and are separated by immunophenotype (CD5, CD23, cyclin D1, CD10/BCL6).

ddx.dx: Classic Hodgkin lymphoma or large B-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: These usually form fewer, larger, irregular fleshy masses rather than innumerable uniform small nodules.
